deviation: Clause 6.3 makes Arcadia's ownership of bespoke deliverables conditional on "Unless a Statement of Work states otherwise", so a SOW could move ownership to Ironbridge. This conflicts with the playbook rule that Arcadia must own bespoke deliverables. Arcadia's ownership also covers only data "made available to Ironbridge", so data Ironbridge generates or derives is not clearly Arcadia's. 6.1 also lets Ironbridge keep anything "developed independently", which is wider than pre-existing tools.
suggested_text: 6.1 Pre-Existing Materials. Each Party retains ownership of its intellectual property that existed before the Effective Date or that is developed independently of this Agreement and without use of the other Party's Confidential Information or Customer Data ("Pre-Existing Materials"). 6.2 Customer Data. Arcadia owns all Customer Data, including all data, content and outputs provided by or on behalf of Arcadia or generated or derived from it in the course of the Services. Arcadia grants Ironbridge a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence during the Term to use Customer Data and Arcadia's software and systems solely to provide the Services. 6.3 Deliverables. Arcadia owns all deliverables created specifically for Arcadia under this Agreement, and Ironbridge assigns to Arcadia all rights in them on creation. This clause may be varied only by an express amendment to this Section 6 signed by both Parties, and a Statement of Work alone cannot vary it. Ironbridge retains ownership of its Pre-Existing Materials and grants Arcadia a non-exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, worldwide licence to use them as incorporated in the deliverables.
